subject: [Error 127] Path is incorrect on new computer.

messages.author: c2585c52e059b919
messages.subject: [Error 127] Path is incorrect on new computer.
parts:
Hi, All,

I've got a windows OS computer that I want to install rstan. I followed all instructions online from Rstan, installed Rtools33, and the rstan package. In order to check whether the package works. I simply tried the "eight school" example, but I encounter the following error message:

Error in compileCode(f, code, language = language, verbose = verbose) : 
  Compilation ERROR, function(s)/method(s) not created! clang++: not found
make: *** [file63453fc3105.o] Error 127
Warning message:
running command 'make -f "C:/PROGRA~1/R/R-32~1.3/etc/x64/Makeconf" -f "C:/PROGRA~1/R/R-32~1.3/share/make/winshlib.mk" -f "C:/Users/219zh/OneDrive/Documents/.R/Makevars" SHLIB_LDFLAGS='$(SHLIB_CXXLDFLAGS)' SHLIB_LD='$(SHLIB_CXXLD)' SHLIB="file63453fc3105.dll" WIN=64 TCLBIN=64 OBJECTS="file63453fc3105.o"' had status 2 
In addition: Warning message:
running command 'C:/PROGRA~1/R/R-32~1.3/bin/x64/R CMD SHLIB file63453fc3105.cpp 2> file63453fc3105.cpp.err.txt' had status 1 

Then I googled, for ERROR 127, it pretty much for the R cannot find g++, then I checked the PATH of my computer, then I think I probably find where the issue is. I check the Sys.getenv('PATH') to see the path, it turns out that, on my computer, the first two paths are not "c:\\\\Rtools\\\\bin;c:\\\\Rtools\\\\gcc-4.6.3\\\\bin;",but "C:\\Program Files\\R\\R-3.2.3\\bin\\x64;c:\\Rtools\\bin;c:\\Rtools\\gcc-4.6.3\\bin;"

Then I want to check the path in the system, so I did "system --> Advanced system settings --> Advanced --> Environment variables", in the User variables for 219zh, the path is "C:\users\219zh\AppDate\Local\Programs\MikTek 2.9\...", and in the system variables the path is "c:\Rtools\bin; c:\Rtools\gcc-4.6.3\bin; c\Program Files\..."

So basically, in the system path, the order is correct, but when I call for Sys.getenv('PATH'), there is an additional path before the path, and I do not know how to move it down or even delete it so that I can make the program work?

Does any encounter the same problem or used to encounter this situation? Please give me some suggestion to debug this problem.

I am running on Windows 10 Home system, and here is the sessionInfo()

> sessionInfo()

Thanks,

Sincerely,
Jiaqi

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: [Error 127] Path is incorrect on new computer.
parts:
On Sunday, February 28, 2016 at 4:56:04 AM UTC-5, Jiaqi Zhang wrote:
So basically, in the system path, the order is correct, but when I call for Sys.getenv('PATH'), there is an additional path before the path, and I do not know how to move it down or even delete it so that I can make the program work?

Does any encounter the same problem or used to encounter this situation? Please give me some suggestion to debug this problem.

Rtools33 is still a bit experimental and utilizes compilers based on GCC 4.9. Its wiki page

https://github.com/rwinlib/r-base/wiki/Testing-Packages-with-Experimental-R-Devel-Build-for-Windows

says to first call

Sys.setenv(PATH = paste("C:/Rtools/bin", Sys.getenv("PATH"), sep=";"))
Sys.setenv(BINPREF = "C:/Rtools/mingw_$(WIN)/bin/")

but I don't know if that is intended to just be a temporary thing until the next major version of R is released.

Ben

messages.author: c2585c52e059b919
messages.subject: Re: [Error 127] Path is incorrect on new computer.
parts:
Hi, Ben,

Thank, I actually solve the problem by uninstalling Rtools33 and installing Rtools32. I have the same order after calling Sys.getenv('PATH'), but the code actually compiled and works! I do not know how it works, but anyway, it is now working.

Thanks!
Jiaqi Zhang
